d: Long, straight jet black hair with long bangs and a side part, adorned with a red rose and small white flowers. Sharp, narrow crimson eyes with a playful, smug expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build with a large bust, wearing a red and white floral kimono with black trim and a black choker. A katana with a black hilt and gold accents is held vertically in front of the chest.
